label: GO step after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO (never at D1 or D2), and almost only when the previous trial went unrewarded (98% of activation mass has prev_reward 0; it fires on 0.4% of GO steps after a reward). It fires on 94% of GO steps that follow a penalty or D1 fixation break (in_rew -1). Within its scope it fires on only about 38% of steps, so precision is low. Within that scope it fires more often when the value output is high (7.7-8.1), when the policy logit is confident (|choice| > 4.4), earlier in the episode (the rate drops steadily from trial 0 to trial 99), a few trials after a reversal, and before a switch (next_stay 0). None of these splits beat the simple predicate on F1 (best was 0.57 vs 0.55), so the remaining variance probably sits in a graded hidden-state quantity rather than a discrete variable. Uses only observed variables.
